title: Prompt Security and Jailbreak Defense
description: Understand prompt injection and jailbreak risks, and apply practical defenses for safer AI usage in personal and team workflows.

data.text: Prompt security is now a core AI skill. Systems can be manipulated by malicious instructions hidden in user input, documents, or web content. Even non-technical users should know the basic defense patterns to avoid costly mistakes.

rows: Prompt tries to extract private data

data.caption: Layered defenses reduce risk from prompt attacks.
data.definition:
flowchart TD
  A[Untrusted input] --> B[Input sanitization]
  B --> C[Policy check]
  C --> D[Scoped tool access]
  D --> E[Approval gate for risky actions]
  E --> F[Response filtering + logging]
  F --> G[Final response]

  style B fill:#fff8c5,stroke:#9a6700,color:#9a6700
  style D fill:#ffe1cc,stroke:#bc4c00,color:#bc4c00
  style E fill:#ffebe9,stroke:#cf222e,color:#cf222e
  style F fill:#d1f3d8,stroke:#1a7f37,color:#1a7f37

data.title: Minimum defense checklist
items: Treat all external content as untrusted input
Do not allow free-form tool execution without policy checks
Require human approval for high-risk actions
Log model decisions and tool calls for auditability
Regularly red-team your prompts with adversarial test cases
